name: Parallel Search
description: Web search and content extraction via Parallel (https://parallel.ai), exposed as three declarative HTTP tools. Provides the swappable `web.search` and `web.extract` layers, so selecting it in the layer picker re-points the stable `web.search` / `web.extract` tools at Parallel without changing what agents call. Search works with NO key through Parallel's public Search MCP endpoint; a BYOK Parallel API key unlocks the higher-limit REST API and extraction.
tagline: Objective-driven web search built for agent loops

config.description: Web search that takes a natural-language objective plus 2-3 keyword queries and returns ranked URLs with long, LLM-ready markdown excerpts. There is no result-count parameter: size the response with max_chars_total instead. Requires RYU_PARALLEL_API_KEY.

objective.description: Natural-language description of the question driving the search. Should be self-contained and atomic — one specific piece of information.

search_queries.description: Concise keyword search queries, 3-6 words each. At least one is required; 2-3 give the best results.

mode.description: Search preset. turbo is the fastest, basic is the low-latency agent-loop default used here, advanced does more retrieval and compression (Parallel's own default when omitted).

max_chars_total.description: Upper bound on total characters across the excerpts of all results.

config.description: Web search through Parallel's PUBLIC Search MCP endpoint, which needs no API key. Rate-limited free tier, intended as the zero-setup path when RYU_PARALLEL_API_KEY is unset; add a key to use the higher-limit parallel.search instead. Speaks JSON-RPC: the caller supplies the whole `tools/call` envelope, and the reply is a plain JSON-RPC response whose result payload is a JSON string, so the capability adapter parses it rather than a response map.

params.description: `{name, arguments}` naming the Parallel MCP tool to call (web_search or web_fetch) and its arguments.

config.description: Fetch up to 20 URLs and return their readable content as markdown. Parallel returns objective-focused excerpts by default; this tool asks for full page content instead, so a caller that wanted the whole page gets it. Requires RYU_PARALLEL_API_KEY.

urls.description: URLs to extract content from. Up to 20 per request.

objective.description: Natural-language description of what to look for in these URLs, used to focus the excerpts.

search_queries.description: Keyword queries (3-6 words each) used with the objective to focus excerpts. Pass the queries from the search that surfaced these URLs.

max_chars_total.description: Upper bound on total characters across all extracted results.

fields.label: Parallel API key
fields.description: Create a key at https://platform.parallel.ai and paste it here. Stored encrypted on this node and never shown again — re-paste to change it. Without a key `web.search` still works through Parallel's free public Search MCP endpoint, but `web.extract` returns nothing and falls back to whichever other provider you select.
